head: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
Genera ejemplos de fine-tuning de FLUJOS MULTI-PASO (encadenamiento real de tools)
para Gemma 4. 8 flujos x 6 ejemplos = 48, repartidos en 6 idiomas (es,en,pt,fr,de,it).
Acciones verificadas contra el schema real del repo:
media_edit:     trim, extract_audio, transcode, thumbnail
creative_local: submit, wait, result
backup_sync:    backup_create, verify
developer:      run_tests, git_status
container:      compose_up, compose_ps   (compose_ps = "ps" en contexto compose)
database:       list_tables, query
download:       fetch, hash
Salida: ms_techmedia.jsonl (esquema EXACTO pedido por el usuario).
import json
import os
# Cada entrada: (user_text, lang, correct_tools, step_actions, correct_reply_style)
ROWS = []
def add(user_text, lang, tools, actions, reply):
assert len(tools) == len(actions), f"len mismatch: {user_text}"
ROWS.append({
"user_text": user_text,
"prev_text": "",
"lang": lang,
"correct_tools": tools,
"also_valid": [],
"n_steps": len(tools),
"correct_reply_style": reply,
"reply_is_template": False,
"category": "encadenamiento",
"personality_applies": False,
"original_was_correct": True,
"confidence": 0.9,
"source": "synthetic_multistep",
"project": "gemma4",
"dataset_part": "multistep_flows",
